description: Source code for the LoginScreen widget in a Flutter app, handling user login via password or OTP, password reset, and related UI interactions.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget providing login UI with options for password or OTP, including password reset functionality.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the logic, interactions, and UI state for LoginScreen.

methods.name: _loginWithPassword
methods.description: Handles login attempt with password, including validation, API call, and error handling.

methods.name: _verifyOtpAndLogin
methods.description: Verifies entered OTP and logs in upon success, including validation and API interaction.

methods.name: _passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Initiates password reset process by requesting OTP and informing user.
